common.tagline: Post it free. Sell it near you.

hero.headline: Kenya’s social local marketplace—tuned to what you like, and where you are.
hero.subheadline: Scroll real things being sold around you: cars in Rongai, phones in town, furniture down the road, fresh produce from a farmer nearby. Shopi also learns what you keep opening and saves your taste, so the feed stays local and relevant. When something feels right, message the seller and agree directly. Shopi does not take payments or commission.
hero.reassurance: Free to browse · Free to post · Buyer and seller agree directly

features.headline: Find it nearby. Message the seller. Agree between yourselves.

scroll.title: Discovery beats typing and hoping
scroll.body: Search works when you already know the exact words. Shopi is for the other moments too: you scroll a local feed and come across a sofa, a clean phone, a car, a pair of shoes, or produce you were not planning to search for.

message.title: The deal stays between buyer and seller
message.body: There is no cart, checkout, escrow or Shopi agent holding money. Tap to chat, ask for more photos, negotiate, choose where to meet or how to deliver, and close the deal your way.

local.title: Nearby sellers show up first
local.body: A buyer in Meru should not start with random listings from far away. Shopi uses location to bring nearby posts forward, while still letting good listings travel across Kenya when they match what people like.

ai.title: Your feed gets more relevant over time
ai.body: Shopi looks at what you open, save and message, then surfaces more of that kind of thing. Keep clicking land listings and you will see more plots. Spend time on TVs, phones or fashion, and the feed adjusts with you.

tiktok.title: Post once, share it everywhere
tiktok.body: Make a post on Shopi and send it straight to TikTok in the same go. Reach the people scrolling there, and bring them back to a real listing with price, location, seller and a direct way to message.

free.title: Free to list. Free to browse.
free.body: Shopi is here to connect people, not to sit inside the transaction. Sellers keep their price, buyers talk directly, and both sides decide what happens next.

howItWorks.headline: Four steps, and your item is in front of nearby buyers.
howItWorks.intro: There is no long form to fight with and nothing to pay. Create a free account, add your photos, let Shopi Agent draft the words, then publish. Your listing enters the local feed straight away.

1.title: Create your free account
1.body: Sign up with Google, with an email address, or with Apple on an iPhone. You do not need a registered business, a website or a verified phone number to sell here.

2.title: Add photos or a video
2.body: Shoot the item on your phone, or import a video you already made on TikTok. Clear media is what makes a buyer stop scrolling and open your listing.

3.title: Let Shopi Agent write it
3.body: Upload a photo and Shopi Agent drafts the title, description, category and specifications. You read it over and change anything you want before it goes live.

4.title: Publish and reply to buyers
4.body: Set your price in shillings, mark it negotiable if you like, and publish. Nearby buyers see it in the feed and message you inside Shopi, where you agree the price and the pickup directly.

audience.headline: For the people already buying and selling in Kenya every day.

buyers.title: Find useful things before you think to search.
buyers.body: Maybe you came for a phone and ended up spotting a sofa, a good mitumba bale, a used car, or fresh produce nearby. Shopi keeps discovery open, uses your interests to tune the feed, then lets you message the seller when something makes sense.

sellers.title: Your phone can put the item in front of nearby buyers.
sellers.body: Record what you are selling, add the price and location, and post. Buyers discover it in the feed and message you directly. No website, no checkout setup, no commission removed from your sale.

testimonials.headline: Everyday sellers. Real items. No shopfront required.

download.headline: Post it today. Let nearby buyers come to you.
download.body: Create your free account, put up what you are selling, and buyers in your area find it in the feed and message you. Posting costs nothing, Shopi takes no commission, and you keep every shilling you agree with the buyer.
download.reassurance: Free to post · 0% commission · No business registration needed

pillars.headline: Your item gets found without paying to be seen.
pillars.intro: Shopi is a feed, not a search box. People scroll it the way they scroll social apps, and listings near them come first — so your post reaches buyers who were not searching for it yet. Free to post, no commission, and every message lands with you.

feed.title: A feed, not a search box
feed.tagline: Buyers come across your item while scrolling, not only when they search the exact words.

chat.title: Buyers message you directly
chat.tagline: No cart, no checkout, no agent in between. You answer, you negotiate, you agree the pickup.

sell.title: Shopi Agent writes the listing

stats.headline: No commission. No listing fees. Nothing deducted.
stats.intro: Shopi never sits inside your transaction. It does not process payments, hold your money or arrange delivery — which is exactly why there is nothing for it to take out of your sale.

zero.label: Commission and listing fees
zero.body: Posting is free and Shopi takes nothing from the sale. The buyer pays you directly, not us.

counties.label: Counties, one feed
counties.body: Nearby posts surface first — Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru, Meru and every town in between.

chat.label: Chat, from first message to deal
chat.body: Buyers reach you inside Shopi. Answer questions, agree a price and set the pickup without leaving the app.

feed.title: Find what you didn't know you were looking for.
feed.body: Shopi is not just a search box. The feed learns what you open, save and message about, and puts listings near you first — from phones and furniture to fresh produce and cars.

chat.body: When you find the right item, message the seller inside Shopi. Price, payment and pickup are agreed between the two of you. Shopi never holds the money, so there is nothing to deduct and nobody to wait on.

tiktokSaver.body: Paste a TikTok link and save the video to your device without the watermark — handy when you want to reuse your own product videos on Shopi, WhatsApp status, or anywhere else.
